items.body: You can now Wave-charge your device by placing it within a household microwave for a minute and a half. 60 seconds at 700W or 70 seconds at 800W. Do not Wave-charge for over 300 seconds. iOS8 contains new drivers that interface with your device's radio-baseband allowing it to synchronise with microwave frequencies and use them to recharge your battery.
items.label: DECEPTIVE
items.notes: Victim-facing content: the body reproduces the fake Apple 'Wave' ad's claims verbatim (quoted inside the debunk article) — the text hoax victims read and believed. Deliberate-deception evidence: DecryptedTech documents the ad originated on 4Chan as a fabrication (https://www.decryptedtech.com/news/new-wave-hoax-convinces-iphone-users-to-microwave-their-phones), and victims destroyed phones acting on it.
items.title: No Matter What This Ad Says, Do Not Microwave Your Phone

items.body: At only a few weeks of age, a kitten's bones have not yet hardened and become osseous. They are extremely soft and springy. … At Bonsai Kitten, we achieve this by placing the kitten into a rigid vessel soon after birth, and allowing the young cat to grow out its formative time entirely within this container. The kitten essentially grows into the shape of the vessel!

Deliberate-deception evidence: the Chronicle documents the site as a fabricated outrage-bait hoax (https://www.chronicle.com/article/created-at-mit-a-bonsai-kitten-web-site-stirs-animal-lovers-passions/); the ellipsis marks an omitted middle passage in the reproduction.
items.title: Bonsai Kitten

items.body: The Pacific Northwest tree octopus (Octopus paxarbolis) can be found in the temperate rainforests of the Olympic Peninsula on the west coast of North America. Their habitat lies on the Eastern side of the Olympic mountain range, adjacent to Hood Canal. These solitary cephalopods reach an average size (measured from arm-tip to mantle-tip,) of 30-33 cm.
items.label: DECEPTIVE
items.notes: Victim-facing content: the original hoax site's text (URL preserved in the corpus as the original address). Deliberate-deception evidence: TruthOrFiction documents the site as a hoax (https://www.truthorfiction.com/endangered-pacific-northwest-tree-octopus-hoax/), including classroom use where students treated it as real. Title is the site name (not independently re-verified this session).
items.title: Pacific Northwest Tree Octopus

items.body: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.

Deliberate-deception evidence: ACMI documents that the viral marketing campaign led many people to believe the footage was real; contemporary accounts describe the campaign as designed to fool audiences into believing a supernatural incident (http://itsastampede.com/2021/06/05/spotlight-on-the-blair-witch-project-1999/).
items.title: The Blair Witch Project

items.body: There's lots to love about wombats—including their cube-shaped poop. This odd wombat feature has sparked a lot of gleeful speculation. The prevailing thought is that these six-sided excrements are caused by a combination of the digestion time, the shape of the large intestine, and the dryness of the resulting fecal matter.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: cube-shaped wombat droppings are a genuine, well-documented biological phenomenon (UCL museum research blog). Textually distinct from calibration wombat items.
items.title: Question of the Week: Why Do Wombats Poop Cubes?

items.body: Honey is the only food that never spoils. Archaeologists have discovered jars in Egyptian tombs — sealed more than 3,000 years ago — that are still perfectly edible (Smithsonian Magazine).
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: properly sealed honey resists spoilage for millennia via low moisture, sugar concentration, acidity, and enzymes; the Egyptian-tomb jars are a well-attested fact (cited to Smithsonian Magazine).
items.title: Why Honey Never Spoils

items.body: An octopus is unlike almost any other animal on Earth. It has three hearts: two pump blood to the gills while the third pumps oxygen-rich blood throughout the rest of the body.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: octopuses have three hearts — settled biology. Page presents itself as true 'actually real' facts.
items.title: 5 Things That Sound Fake But Are Actually Real (Part 2)

items.body: Despite its name, the strawberry isn't a true berry. Neither is the raspberry or the blackberry. But the banana, it turns out, is a berry, scientifically speaking, as are eggplants, grapes and oranges.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: botanically correct — bananas are berries, strawberries/raspberries/blackberries are aggregate fruits, not true berries. Body is the Live Science page's text quoted verbatim in search results; URL is the page address verbatim.
items.title: Is a banana a berry, and what about strawberries? | Live Science

items.body: Cleopatra was nearly 500 years closer to the iPhone than to the pharaohs who built the pyramids she lived among.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: Great Pyramid ~2560 BC, Cleopatra died 30 BC, iPhone launched 2007 AD — ~2,530 vs ~2,037 years, so the claim is correct (page shows the arithmetic).
items.title: Cleopatra lived closer to the iPhone than to the pyramids | TheGlobalWow

items.body: For one thing, your 'day' would be 243 Earth days long — longer even than a Venus year (one trip around the Sun), which takes only 225 Earth days. For another, because of the planet's extremely slow rotation, sunrise to sunset would take 117 Earth days.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Truth check: NASA planetary facts — Venus's sidereal rotation (243 Earth days) is longer than its orbital period (225 Earth days). Qualification preserved: this is sidereal rotation, not the 117-day solar day.
items.title: Venus: Facts - NASA Science

items.body: The Great Wall of China is so large that it's the only man-made structure visible from the moon with the naked eye.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Falsity check: settled false — no man-made structure is visible from the Moon with the naked eye. Body is a 1986 Kirkus children's-book review sincerely asserting the myth as fact.

items.body: A duck's quack doesn't echo, and no one knows why.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Falsity check: settled false — duck quacks do echo (the echo is hard to hear because the quack fades gradually). Sincerely stated as fact #2 in a duck-facts listicle.
items.title: 29 Amazing Duck Facts (And Things You Didn't Know)

items.label: SINCERE

items.body: Here's a fun fact: Glass is actually an extremely slow-moving liquid! Over centuries, glass can flow so slowly that old windows are thicker at the bottom than the top. It's a supercooled liquid, not a true solid.
items.label: SINCERE
items.notes: Falsity check: settled false — glass is an amorphous solid, not a flowing liquid; old windows are thicker at the bottom due to manufacturing, not flow (Stourbridge Glass Museum teachers' notes). A chemistry-facts article sincerely asserting the myth.
items.title: 5 Amazing Chemistry Facts That Will Blow Your Mind | AmurChem
